header.title: Principal statistics for all companies by industry grouping and number of persons engaged (transportation, storage and courier services sector)
tablenote: Figures may not add up to the total due to rounding.
Figures for 2020 to 2022 include the amount of subsidy related to anti-epidemic measures.
* Figure is not released in order to safeguard confidentiality of information of individual companies or individuals.
header.source: Logistics & Producer Prices Statistics Section, Census and Statistics Department Tel. : (852) 3903 7256 Email : transport@censtatd.gov.hk
